notes.title: Fairy of the treasures release in steam!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31262244/4e90597093b87a85e56ff482656c7888a2117408.png
While we are working on improving Truth: Disorder, please note our new game!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/770400/Fairy_of_the_treasures/

We plan to develop the game, add new levels and achievements.

In the release version, the story mode will be small, since the game was originally conceived as a clicker. it's kind of an experiment for us and if players like it we will continue to develop. and yes, we are planning updates (for example - on holidays).
